mapper.select: SELECT user_search_history_id, user_no, target_user_no, searched_at FROM ultary_user_search_history WHERE user_search_history_id = #{userSearchHistoryId} AND user_no = #{viewerUserNo}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ultary_user_search_history ( user_no, target_user_no, searched_at ) VALUES ( #{userNo}, #{targetUserNo}, NOW() ) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE searched_at = NOW()
mapper.select: SELECT h.user_search_history_id, h.target_user_no, h.searched_at, u.nickname, ( SELECT rp.profile_file_id FROM ultary_pet rp WHERE rp.user_no = u.user_no AND rp.is_deleted = 0 AND rp.profile_file_id IS NOT NULL ORDER BY rp.priority ASC, rp.pet_id ASC LIMIT 1 ) AS profileFileId FROM ultary_user_search_history h INNER JOIN ultary_user u ON u.user_no = h.target_user_no WHERE h.user_no = #{viewerUserNo} AND h.target_user_no = #{targetUserNo}
